reviews.comment: The booking in and follow up was excellent. So simple, incredibly friendly, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Eurotech Auto Repair

Appreciate the timely response. The car looks great. Thanks for your help.
Very happy with the work. Thank you to the team.
Best panel beaters in Auckland for European vehicles! Fixed my Mini Cooper perfectly. Marino really knows his stuff.
Very professional workshop. Quality of work on my BMW 3 Series was exceptional. Highly recommended.
They handled my insurance claim seamlessly and the repair quality on my Land Rover is outstanding. Will definitely return.
